Surya Namaskar consists of a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas [PROG_Y_001]. It is best performed early morning on an empty stomach, and each posture is coordinated with your breath [PROG_Y_001]. 

Ek complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left [PROG_Y_001]. Regular practice provides a cardiovascular workout, improves digestion, helps with weight loss (वजन घटाना), and reduces stress (*tanav*) [PROG_Y_001]. If you have back problems, hernia, or high blood pressure, consult a doctor or certified instructor first [PROG_Y_001].

Anulom Vilom Pranayama ke fayde yeh hain ki yeh mind ko calm karta hai aur stress ko relieve karta hai [PROG_P_001]. Yeh body mein Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ko balance karne mein madad karta hai aur patience aur concentration ko improve karta hai [PROG_P_001].

Ek healthy lifestyle ke liye balanced diet zaroori hai jisme carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins aur minerals hone chahiye [PROG_D_001].

Breakfast mein fried foods ki jagah poha, upma, ya idli le sakte hain [PROG_D_001]. Lunch mein 2 rotis, ek bowl dal, sabzi, aur thoda salad khayein [PROG_D_001]. Dinner sabse halka hona chahiye, jiske liye khichdi ya dal ke sath vegetable stir-fry achha option hai [PROG_D_001]. Seasonal fruits aur vegetables shamil karein, aur roz kam se kam 8-10 glasses paani piyein [PROG_D_001]. Processed sugar aur excessive salt se bachein [PROG_D_001].

Agar aapko is program ke baare mein aur kuch janna hai ya care coordinator se connect karna hai, toh batayein!

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that cleanses the body through active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation [PROG_P_002]. Sit comfortably with a straight spine, take a deep breath in, and exhale in short, powerful bursts while your stomach pumps inwards [PROG_P_002]. 

Start with 20-30 pumps and do up to 3 rounds with breaks [PROG_P_002]. It stimulates digestion, improves metabolic rate, and aids weight loss [PROG_P_002]. Practice on an empty stomach in the morning [PROG_P_002]. 

Avoid it if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana, or Triangle Pose, is a foundational standing pose that stretches the entire body [PROG_Y_003]. To do it, stand with your feet wide apart, turn your right foot out 90 degrees and your left foot in slightly, then extend your torso to the right and place your right hand on your shin, ankle, or the floor while extending your left arm up [PROG_Y_003]. 

It stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine, strengthens the legs and core, helps with stress, and improves digestion [PROG_Y_003]. Avoid this pose if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury, and remember not to lock your knees [PROG_Y_003]. Hold for 30-60 seconds [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye aap Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) kar sakte hain [PROG_P_004]. 

Comfortable baith kar apni jeebh (tongue) ko tube shape mein roll karein aur mooh se bahar nikalein [PROG_P_004]. Tube ke zariye dheere aur gehre saans (inhale) lein [PROG_P_004]. Phir jeebh andar karke mooh band karein aur naak (nostrils) se dheere se saans chorein [PROG_P_004]. Isko 5-10 times repeat karein [PROG_P_004]. 

Yeh body aur mind ko cool karta hai, agitation kam karta hai, aur hunger aur thirst ko control karne mein help karta hai [PROG_P_004]. Low blood pressure ya respiratory issues jaise asthma wale ise na karein [PROG_P_004]. Clean environment mein practice karein [PROG_P_004].

Immunity badhane ke liye ek balanced diet lena zaroori hai. Citrus fruits jaise amla, oranges, aur lemons Vitamin C ke rich source hain [PROG_D_002]. Turmeric (haldi) mein curcumin hota hai, jo ek powerful anti-inflammatory compound hai [PROG_D_002]. 

Ginger aur garlic bhi medicinal properties ke liye acche hain [PROG_D_002]. Yogurt probiotics ka great source hai jo gut health ke liye accha hai [PROG_D_002]. Green leafy vegetables jaise spinach (palak) antioxidants se packed hain, aur almonds Vitamin E ka great source hain [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience who began his journey in Rishikesh learning from traditional yoga gurus [PROG_I_001]. His teaching style blends classical Hatha yoga with modern Vinyasa flow, focusing on alignment and breath [PROG_I_001]. He specializes in therapeutic yoga, helping clients manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains making a comeback, serving as a modern superfood for a healthy lifestyle [PROG_D_004]. They are gluten-free and rich in fiber, protein, and antioxidants [PROG_D_004]. 

Different varieties offer specific benefits: Ragi (Finger Millet) provides calcium for bone health, Jowar (Sorghum) is packed with iron and protein, and Bajra (Pearl Millet) is rich in magnesium for heart health [PROG_D_004]. 

Due to being high in fiber, they aid in weight management and have a low glycemic index, making them suitable for diabetics [PROG_D_004].

You can relax using Shavasana (Corpse Pose). Lie flat on your back with feet spread comfortably, arms alongside your body with palms up, close your eyes, and release tension (*thakaan*). Stay in this pose for 5-10 minutes to reduce blood pressure, calm the nervous system, and combat insomnia [PROG_Y_004]. 

Alternatively, try Balasana (Childs Pose) by kneeling, sitting on your heels, and folding forward with your forehead on the floor. Hold for 30 seconds to a few minutes with deep breathing to calm the brain, relieve back pain, and alleviate stress [PROG_Y_005].

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Masters degree in Food and Nutrition [PROG_I_002]. She follows a no-deprivation approach and creates sustainable diet plans that fit your lifestyle and cultural eating habits [PROG_I_002]. You can book a one-on-one consultation with her to create a khaane ka plan (eating plan) [PROG_I_002]. She is available on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM [PROG_I_002].

Staying hydrated is crucial for overall health because water regulates body temperature, lubricates joints, and helps deliver nutrients to cells [PROG_D_003]. Dehydration can cause headaches, fatigue, and poor concentration [PROG_D_003]. 

You should aim for 8-10 glasses of water per day, and drinking water before meals can aid in weight management [PROG_D_003]. It is also essential for kidney function and flushing out toxins [PROG_D_003].
